variables.$fxv#1:
// AzMaintenance_Events
// purpose: one row per (subscription, TrackingId): the preferred source row (arg > rest > activitylog), deduplicated.
//          Count events with dcount(tracking_id) (method item 3). Class: Unplanned = ServiceIssue, Planned = PlannedMaintenance, Advisory = the rest.
// inputs: includeSynthetic:bool=false
// outputs: subscription_id, tracking_id, event_type, class, status, level, event_title, impact_start_utc, impact_end_utc, last_update_utc,
//          first_seen_utc, services, regions, source, platform_initiated, exposure_h (window, NOT downtime), end_basis, is_open
//          end_basis: mitigation_time | last_update (resolved but no mitigation time published: window ends at the last update) | open (ends now)
let ledger = AzSvcHealthEvents_CL
    | where includeSynthetic or is_synthetic != true
    | summarize arg_max(ingested_utc, *) by row_key
    | project subscription_id, tracking_id, event_type, status, level, event_title, impact_start_utc, impact_end_utc,
              last_update_utc, platform_initiated, services, regions, source;
let activity = union isfuzzy=true
    (AzureActivity
        | where CategoryValue == "ServiceHealth"
        | extend p = todynamic(Properties)
        | extend incident = tostring(p.incidentType)
        | project subscription_id = tostring(SubscriptionId),
                  tracking_id = tostring(p.trackingId),
                  event_type = case(incident == "Incident", "ServiceIssue",
                                    incident == "Maintenance", "PlannedMaintenance",
                                    incident == "Security", "SecurityAdvisory",
                                    "HealthAdvisory"),
                  status = tostring(p.stage),
                  level = tostring(Level),
                  event_title = tostring(p["title"]),
                  impact_start_utc = todatetime(p.impactStartTime),
                  impact_end_utc = todatetime(coalesce(tostring(p.impactMitigationTime), tostring(p.endTime))),
                  last_update_utc = TimeGenerated,
                  platform_initiated = true,
                  services = pack_array(tostring(p.service)),
                  regions = pack_array(tostring(p.region)),
                  source = "activitylog"),
    (ledger | take 0);
let rows = union ledger, activity | where isnotempty(tracking_id);
let first_seen = rows | summarize first_seen_utc = min(last_update_utc) by subscription_id, tracking_id;
rows
| extend src_rank = case(source == "arg", 1, source == "rest", 2, 3)
| summarize arg_max(last_update_utc, *) by subscription_id, tracking_id, source
| summarize arg_min(src_rank, *) by subscription_id, tracking_id
| join kind=leftouter first_seen on subscription_id, tracking_id
| extend class = case(event_type =~ "ServiceIssue", "Unplanned", event_type =~ "PlannedMaintenance", "Planned", "Advisory"),
         is_open = status !in~ ("Resolved", "Complete", "Completed", "Mitigated")
| extend end_eff = case(isnotnull(impact_end_utc), impact_end_utc, is_open, now(), last_update_utc),
         end_basis = case(isnotnull(impact_end_utc), "mitigation_time", is_open, "open", "last_update")
| extend exposure_h = round(todouble(datetime_diff("minute", end_eff, impact_start_utc)) / 60.0, 2)
| project subscription_id, tracking_id, event_type, class, status, level, event_title, impact_start_utc, impact_end_utc, last_update_utc,
          first_seen_utc, services, regions, source, platform_initiated, exposure_h, end_basis, is_open
variables.$fxv#4:
// AzMaintenance_ResourceIntervals
// purpose: Resource Health Unavailable/Degraded intervals per resource, classified Planned/Unplanned (method items 1-2).
//          Interval opens when the state becomes Unavailable (or Degraded) and closes at the next state change; Unknown rows and duplicate
//          Active/Updated rows are ignored; open intervals end at now() and are flagged. Per resource the state sequence is linear, so
//          intervals never overlap (no merge needed in KQL; analytics/intervals.py merges generically).
// inputs: includeSynthetic:bool=false
// outputs: subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, service_name, category, state, start_utc, end_utc, minutes, is_open, stale_open, cause,
//          stale_open = open for more than 3 days with no closing event (typically a deleted or deallocated resource): kept for
//          inspection but excluded from downtime and availability (docs/decisions.md D-07).
//          user_initiated, class, classification_basis, planned_tracking_id
let rh_ledger = AzResourceHealthEvents_CL
    | where includeSynthetic or is_synthetic != true
    | summarize arg_max(ingested_utc, *) by row_key
    | project event_data_id, resource_id = tolower(resource_id), subscription_id, status, current_status, cause, event_utc;
let rh_activity = union isfuzzy=true
    (AzureActivity
        | where CategoryValue == "ResourceHealth"
        | extend p = todynamic(Properties)
        | project event_data_id = tostring(EventDataId),
                  resource_id = tolower(coalesce(ResourceId, _ResourceId)),
                  subscription_id = tostring(SubscriptionId),
                  status = tostring(ActivityStatusValue),
                  current_status = tostring(p.currentHealthStatus),
                  cause = tostring(p.cause),
                  event_utc = TimeGenerated),
    (rh_ledger | take 0);
let cat = AzMaintenance_Catalog(includeSynthetic) | project service_name, arm_type, category;
let ann = AzVmAnnotations_CL
    | where includeSynthetic or is_synthetic != true
    | summarize arg_max(ingested_utc, *) by row_key
    | project resource_id = tolower(resource_id), ann_time = occurred_utc, ann_category = category, ann_context = context;
let planned = AzMaintenance_Events(includeSynthetic)
    | where class == "Planned"
    | mv-expand service_name = services to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(service_name)
    | project subscription_id, planned_id = tracking_id, service_name, p_start = impact_start_utc, p_end = coalesce(impact_end_utc, now());
union rh_ledger, rh_activity
| summarize arg_max(event_utc, *) by event_data_id
| where current_status in~ ("Available", "Unavailable", "Degraded")
| extend state = current_status
| sort by resource_id asc, event_utc asc
| extend prev_res = prev(resource_id), prev_state = prev(state)
| where prev_res != resource_id or prev_state != state
| extend next_res = next(resource_id), next_time = next(event_utc)
| where state in~ ("Unavailable", "Degraded")
| extend start_utc = event_utc, is_open = next_res != resource_id
| extend end_utc = iff(is_open, now(), next_time)
| extend after_providers = extract(@".*/providers/(.*)$", 1, resource_id)
| extend segs = split(after_providers, "/")
| extend resource_type = strcat(segs[0], "/", segs[1], iff(array_length(segs) >= 4, strcat("/", segs[3]), ""), iff(array_length(segs) >= 6, strcat("/", segs[5]), ""))
| project-away after_providers, segs
| extend rt = tolower(resource_type)
| extend minutes = round(todouble(datetime_diff("second", end_utc, start_utc)) / 60.0, 2)
| join kind=leftouter (cat | summarize service_name = take_any(service_name), category = take_any(category) by rt = arm_type) on rt
| project-away rt, rt1
| join kind=leftouter ann on resource_id
| extend ann_match = isnotnull(ann_time) and abs(ann_time - start_utc) <= 15m
| summarize ann_category = take_anyif(ann_category, ann_match), ann_context = take_anyif(ann_context, ann_match)
    by subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, service_name, category, state, start_utc, end_utc, minutes, is_open, cause
| extend user_initiated = cause =~ "UserInitiated" or ann_context in~ ("User-initiated", "VM-initiated")
| join kind=leftouter (planned | summarize by subscription_id, planned_id, service_name, p_start, p_end) on subscription_id, service_name
| extend overlap = isnotnull(p_start) and start_utc < p_end and end_utc > p_start
| summarize planned_tracking_id = take_anyif(planned_id, overlap)
    by subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, service_name, category, state, start_utc, end_utc, minutes, is_open, cause, user_initiated, ann_category
| extend class = case(ann_category in~ ("Planned", "Unplanned"), tostring(ann_category),
                      isnotempty(planned_tracking_id), "Planned",
                      "Unplanned"),
         classification_basis = case(ann_category in~ ("Planned", "Unplanned"), "vm_annotation",
                                     isnotempty(planned_tracking_id), "overlaps_planned_event",
                                     "default"),
         category = coalesce(category, "Unmapped"), service_name = coalesce(service_name, "(unmapped)"),
         stale_open = is_open and start_utc < ago(3d)
| project subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, service_name, category, state, start_utc, end_utc, minutes, is_open, stale_open, cause,
          user_initiated, class, classification_basis, planned_tracking_id

UTC cron schedule. Hourly: the job only does what is due (see src/collector/job.py).

variables.script:
set -e
cd /tmp
python3 -m pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check requests
python3 -c "import os,requests,zipfile;r=requests.get(os.environ['AML_PACKAGE_URL'],timeout=120);r.raise_for_status();open('app.zip','wb').write(r.content);zipfile.ZipFile('app.zip').extractall('app')"
cd app
python3 -m pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements.txt
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m collector.job collect

variables.query:
let enabled = dynamic([{0}]);
let ok = AzMaintenanceIngestHealth_CL
| where ingested_utc > ago(36h) and status in ("success", "partial") and is_synthetic != true
| summarize last_ok = max(finished_utc) by source;
print source = enabled
| mv-expand source to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter ok on source
| where isnull(last_ok)

nextSteps.value: Open Azure Monitor > Workbooks > "Azure Maintenance Ledger". The collector job runs hourly at :15 UTC and the first run loads the history, so data appears within about 90 minutes. See the Data health tab.
